name: Clean (any style)
cue: Bar from the floor to the shoulders, squat or power, elbows through at the top.

name: Ground-to-overhead
cue: Floor to lockout overhead any way: snatch, or clean and jerk.

name: Barbell overhead walking lunge
cue: Bar locked out overhead, long steps, back knee kisses the floor, stand tall between steps.

name: Dumbbell power clean
cue: Both dumbbells from the floor to the shoulders without a full squat; stand fully before dropping.

name: Dumbbell front squat
cue: Dumbbells on the shoulders, squat below parallel, drive up to full extension.

name: Dumbbell overhead walking lunge
cue: One dumbbell locked out overhead, alternate legs, back knee to the floor, hips open at the top.

name: Wall walk
cue: From chest on the floor, walk the feet up the wall and the hands in until they touch the line, then walk back out to the start.

name: Handstand walk
cue: Kick up, stack the hips over the hands and walk forward in short steps; each 5 ft segment counts.

name: Box jump-over
cue: Jump onto or over the box and land on the far side; no need to stand tall on top.

name: Lateral burpee over dumbbell
cue: Chest to the floor beside the dumbbell, jump up and sideways over it with two feet.

name: Medicine-ball box step-over
cue: Holding the ball, step up onto the box, stand tall and step down the other side.
